assumptions: Primary strips must be physically cut off before processing. Final primary remainder remains waste; never promoted. Single real leading anchor is not required in this separate exam model. Machine feasibility unknown.

semantics.ancestry: all physical rotations inherited through CUT, including trim rotations
semantics.level: raw sheet 0; detached primary strip 1; a rotated strip advances one level on its next CUT; parallel cuts keep level
semantics.sizeSettings: initial setting plus changes of local machine cut coordinate; across-feeds
semantics.solverDepth: not a manufacturing metric; reported by optimizer separately
